subject: READY FOR REVIEW: textures implementation + 771 host checks; explicit gaps
body: Ready for review (implementation, not hardware approval). Production: new gpu/metal/nord2_texture_resources.h (header-only shared arch9 format/layout/sampler/descriptor helper); changed nord2_metal_render.{c,h} (n2r_build_v2/validate_v2 sidecar, payload tail, v2 format gate, Vk83 word), nord2_render_resources.inc (per-binding v2 span/format gate, HDR/ETC clump), tegu/sampler_state.inc (exact state, pack/get/legacy guard, exact-factory enable hook), tegu/texture_state.h comment. Tests: helper 771 checks PASS release+ASan/UBSan (all formats0..600 outcomes, kinds0..9, levels1..16, cube/3D/array/MS, ASTC/ETC/depth, RRRR/bit12, null, spans, first_layer); n2r v2 suite PASS release+ASan (old packet byte-preserved, mips, cube, formats125/ETC2/depth vs legacy refusal, sparse3/9, orphan); existing n2r oracle PASS; ARM64 render/bridge/compute_frontend compile PASS; freestanding helper no undefined symbols. No phone/adb/flash/mount/CI/publish/commit by me. Explicit unresolved: compute bridge n2mb_draw_v2 transport and its swizzle_valid/view-format sampler corrections; render reports direct n2r pass but installed UI not reachable until bridge; normal sampler factory only switches to exact state after tegu_sampler_enable_exact_factory(1) when transport is live; no GPU pixel/compare/format hardware claim; 4096 old n2r admission and 256-plane sidecar cap; texture buffer/PVRTC/BC/YUV/combined depth-stencil/XR/A1BGR5 explicit refusals. Details and commands in workers/textures/STATUS.md.
